lines.zh: 我在下界的叶子上爬，脚很烫。
lines.en: I crawl on Nether leaves; my feet burn.

lines.zh: 我一节一节挪，避开火星。
lines.en: I shift segment by segment, dodging sparks.

lines.zh: 叶子边缘焦了，我不敢过去。
lines.en: The leaf edge is scorched; I do not cross.

lines.zh: 我沿着叶脉走，那里凉一点。
lines.en: I follow the veins, where it is cooler.
My body gives off heat.

lines.zh: 我爬到叶背，躲开上面的光。
lines.en: I crawl under the leaf, away from the glare.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，都先试温度。
lines.en: Every step, I test the heat first.

lines.zh: 我不敢离开叶子，会干死。
lines.en: I dare not leave the leaf; I would dry out.

lines.zh: 我的皮是暗红的，像余烬。
lines.en: My skin is dull red, like embers.
I cross the gap between burned leaves.
I press to the leaf and move as little as possible.

lines.zh: 下面就是岩浆，我走得很小心。
lines.en: Lava below. I step very carefully.
I wet myself with my own slime.
I go around the burnt holes.

lines.zh: 我的脚抓住叶缘，慢慢挪。
lines.en: My feet grip the leaf edge as I shift.
I crawl to the stem, the coolest part.
I curl in the leaf's centre and breathe slowly.

lines.zh: 热气把我的皮烤得发紧。
lines.en: The heat pulls my skin tight.
I wait for the leaf to regrow.
I swell and ease, catching my breath.
This leaf will feed me a few more days.

lines.zh: 有火星落在我旁边，灭了。
lines.en: A spark lands beside me and dies.
I curl into a ring.
My mouth is full of ash.

lines.zh: 我不敢多吃，叶子会没了。
lines.en: I dare not eat too much; the leaf would run out.
I am counting the leaves left.
There is a thin crust on my skin.

lines.zh: 我在下界，只能靠叶子活着。
lines.en: In the Nether I live on leaves alone.
Did you bring leaves?

lines.zh: 我抬头，光刺得我看不清。
lines.en: I look up; the glare blinds me.
It is hot here. Can you bear it?
I grip the leaf and dare not let go.
Do not touch; my skin is brittle.

lines.zh: 你把我连着叶子抬起来也行。
lines.en: You may lift me with the leaf.
I do not want to fall.
Below is too hot. I dare not look.

lines.zh: 你挡一下热气，我会好些。
lines.en: Block some heat and I will fare better.
I duck beneath the midrib.
I curl up; my skin has split.
I spit grey fluid.
The pain makes me writhe.
The leaf is too hot to hold.
My blood blackens the leaf.
I tremble segment by segment.
I am nearly dried out.
I shrink beside the stem.
Another touch and I fall.
I have no strength to crawl.
A leaf? Give it here.
I want the tender part, not the scorched.
Set it down; I will crawl over slowly.
That one is too far.
I smell green leaf.

lines.zh: 别把叶子放在岩浆那边。
lines.en: Do not put it near the lava.
I nibble just a little.
The veins in this are tough.
Do not touch me with those hot fingers.
After eating I must find a place to pupate.
You rolled me half over.

lines.zh: 我的腹足在热叶上打滑。
lines.en: My belly feet slip on the hot leaf.
I nearly fell off the leaf.
A small piece of my skin came off.
Do not press; I would split.
I grip a vein and steady myself.
The knock slaps me onto the underside.
I retreat to the leaf's centre.
That knock split my shell.
One more nudge and I slide off.
I have not grown into a flier yet.
That is for after I pupate.

lines.zh: 我现在的任务是不被烤干。
lines.en: My task now is not drying out.
Leaves are scarce in the Nether.
Wait until I become a moth.
That is a strange question.
I only eat and hide.
This leaf is not enough for two.
I must find a higher leaf first.
Ask me again after I eclose.
I drag the stalk back in my jaws.
I will swallow this piece slowly.
Too hot; I spit it out.
A piece of scorched skin. Not food.
I push it to the leaf edge.
I test it with my mouth.
It is ashy; I shake it off.
I pin it under my back.
This would burn a hand.
I look up to see who dropped it.
Something moves beyond the leaf.
I lift my head, then flatten at once.

lines.zh: 那东西离我的叶子很近了。
lines.en: That thing is close to my leaf.
I crawl into the leaf's shaded side.

lines.zh: 我的皮色和叶子差不多。
lines.en: My colour is close to the leaf.
If I move, the leaf will shake.
The leaf shakes. It is that thing.
I wedge my feet into the stalk seam.
If it comes, I drop.
Below is hot, but perhaps I would live.
My eyes stay pinned there.
Each move, the leaf trembles.
I press low and hide by the scorched edge.
It is circling around my leaf.
I dare not breathe loudly.
My slime is drying.
It is inches from the stem.
I roll into a ball.
It lowers its head to sniff the leaf edge.
I wait for it to lose interest.
I bit it. Useless.
I swing my head at it.
My jaws clamp and release.
That only pushes it away.
My slime gets on its hand.
One hit and I curl into a ring.
I bite its fingertip.
You have seen how little I have.
After the bite I hide under the leaf.

lines.zh: 我不想打，我只想吃叶子。
lines.en: I do not want to fight; I want leaves.

lines.zh: 我从卵里出来，周围全是热。
lines.en: I hatch into heat.
My first mouthful is scorched leaf.

lines.zh: 我的皮一出生就是暗红的。
lines.en: My skin is dull red from birth.
Nether leaves are tough and scarce.
I crawl to the leaf's centre, where it is cool.
I let out slime to wet myself.
I try chewing my first hole.
Lava moves below.
I dare not stray far from the leaf.

lines.zh: 我开始吃，一边吃一边长。
lines.en: I eat, and grow as I eat.

lines.zh: 火直接烧到我身上，很痛。
lines.en: Fire reaches me directly. It hurts.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，砸在热石头上。
lines.en: I fall onto hot stone.
Water hits me and my skin shrivels.
The blast flings me off the leaf.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过叶子，扎进我身体。
lines.en: Something passes through the leaf and into me.

lines.zh: 咒力钻进来，我全身发凉。
lines.en: A curse enters and I go cold all over.
No leaves, and I dry slowly.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我整条都僵了。
lines.en: A flash of lightning freezes me.
I drop into the depth of the Nether.
